answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a challenge word drawn from a randomness beacon, like raven or ocean, and weave it into a signed contribution to the shared ledger. Because the word is unknown until the epoch opens, an attacker cannot precompute template answers for a million fake identities; each sybil must run real inference after the beacon ripples out the word. Cost per fake agent therefore equals genuine compute, making mass identity creation uneconomical.
